text:
support-ryan: Customer flagged a spike of 500s + duplicate billing after upgrading to latest TS + Go SDKs. Escalation: customer hit ~120 failed requests (500) and ~30 duplicate invoices. raising ticket to eng.

devex-anna: ugh. do we have a quick repro? which endpoints and SDK versions?

support-ryan: customer using ts-sdk@1.4.0 and go-sdk v0.9.2. Errors started after they pulled yesterday's release. They call /v1/generate (POST). Logs show 500 with body: `{\"error\":\"internal server error\"}` and our gateway shows the downstream returned 502 for some requests. Billing team says duplicates are for the same job id.

sdk-ci-bot: FYI: openapi spec changed yesterday — `x-client-id` header renamed to `x-rdwd-client` in spec v2.1. That change triggered generator run for TS but Go regen failed in CI (compile error). CI job: `gen:go: failed at model_types.go:211` (link: https://ci.redwood/2345).

sam-eng: this smells like header mismatch causing auth fallback->500s for some clients, and retry logic in Go SDK creating duplicate POSTs. TS SDK got a new header mapping, Go didn't, so some requests lost client id and hit an unexpected code path.

kevin-sre: verified in prod traces: two distinct failure modes: 1) immediate 401/403 for missing client header (we convert to 500 in proxy for backward-compat reasons) 2) transient 502 from model pool, which our client retried at application layer without idempotency. The Go client has retries enabled for all 5xx by default.

lina-ml: interesting — model runtime returns 502 then the request is retried upstream which can allocate a second job. For non-idempotent generate calls that creates duplicates that flow into billing pipeline.

support-ryan: repro snippet from customer (TS):
```js
// ts-sdk v1.4.0
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.generate({ model: 'gpt-large', prompt: 'hi' });
// no x-client-id header shows in outgoing request
```

kevin-sre: repro for Go (shows retries):
```go
cli := sdk.NewClient(os.Getenv("RW_KEY"))
resp, err := cli.Generate(ctx, opts) // retries on 502 by default
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
```

devex-anna: immediate mitigations?

billing-tess: we can void duplicate invoices if you give list of request ids, but we need a root cause to avoid repeat.

sam-eng: short-term: patch Go SDK to honor header alias `x-rdwd-client` -> `x-client-id` mapping and disable automatic retries for POST/generate endpoints. Also add an idempotency key header `Idempotency-Key` for generate calls.

kevin-sre: I'll push a hotfix to proxy to stop converting 401/403 to 500 and return proper 401 so client-side logic will not retry blindly. That reduces duplicates quickly.

lina-ml: add a small change to model runtime to de-dupe identical active jobs for a short window (5s) — low-risk patch but takes a bit more testing.

devex-anna: action list: 1) sam -> patch go-sdk PR to 0.9.3 with header alias + disable POST retries + idempotency header included (PR + changelog) 2) kevin -> proxy hotfix to keep 401/403 3) devex -> update cross-SDK generator pipeline and add CI gating so a failed regen doesn't get merged silently 4) billing-tess -> queue to void duplicates and share list of affected invoices to customer.

sdk-ci-bot: Created ticket RDW-ENG-1223 for regen pipeline gating. CI logs: go-gen failed but TS-gen auto-merged due to missing CI job dependency.

support-ryan: I've given the customer a mitigation: pin TS SDK to 1.3.x and we will issue a patch for Go ASAP. They want status updates every 2 hours.

sam-eng: quick note for changelog: must call out the header rename in OpenAPI and note the aliasing fallback so customers know to pin or upgrade. Also add migration note about idempotency keys for generate POSTs.

devex-anna: can someone drop a short repro test we can add to the cross-sdk smoke suite? suggestion: script that does 10 parallel generate calls with a flaky injected 502 and assert only one billing event produced when idempotency header set.

kevin-sre: putting that test into e2e queue.

billing-tess: I'll prepare the invoice void list after sam sends request ids.

sam-eng: created PR rdw/go-sdk#457 (draft) and rdw/proxy#220 (hotfix) — linking in thread.

support-ryan: thanks all. keeping customer in loop. :( reaction :sweat:

devex-anna: nice work. once PRs are green, let's do a coordinated release note and a short blog post explaining the regen pipeline fix so this doesn't surprise customers again. reaction :thumbsup:

support-ryan: customer confirmed temporary pin works. will update ticket and close once duplicates are voided and Go patch is live.

kevin-sre: last_message: rolling proxy hotfix now to canary region. monitor for duplicate counts.
